attribution: Derived from Tiriac et al., Organoid Profiling Identifies Common Responders to Chemotherapy in Pancreatic Cancer, Cancer Discovery (2018), doi:10.1158/2159-8290.CD-18-0349.

interpretation.method: Manual interpretation checked against the original chart. Days are rounded visual estimates with a five-day reading range, not exact author-supplied event times.
interpretation.author_title: Progression Free Survival in Advanced Disease
interpretation.binary_rule: Label 1 when the known event-free lower bound is at least 182.625 days. Label 0 for observed progression with upper time bound below 182.625 days. An interval crossing the threshold or censoring before it yields an unknown label.
interpretation.censoring: Green bar and arrow: No Evidence of Progression. Read the green shaft endpoint, not the arrow tip.
interpretation.reading_range: The lower/upper range reflects graphical precision and is not a statistical confidence interval. Every recorded range lies on one side of the fixed threshold.
interpretation.hF2: The main text reports initial progression, a switch to second-line gemcitabine/irinotecan/5FU and 388 days of partial response. This corroborates the plotted approximately 390 days; it is not substituted as an exact PFS value. The predeclared primary analysis excludes this sequential-treatment case.
interpretation.hF50: The clinical regimen has only 5FU and is outside the predeclared paired-readout primary analysis. Its erroneous prediction remains visible in the full-nine sensitivity.
interpretation.hF28: The source reports GEM+5FU components; their sequence was uncertain before unblinding. The predeclared strict sensitivity excludes this case.

freeze.scope: Predictions and numerical forecasts were published before reading outcome values. Clinical-figure layout and patient/drug label coordinates had been visible. The source is a retrospective published cohort.
